docs.name: codebase-layout
docs.title: Project Structure and Codebase Layout
docs.description: Overview of the project organization: root-level training scripts, web/ app, src/ (legacy, pending removal), tests/, and how the pieces connect.

docs.name: cfa-pattern-system
docs.title: CFA Pattern Definitions, Masking, and Mosaicing
docs.description: The X-Trans 6x6 and Bayer 2x2 pattern representations, CFA_REGISTRY, make_channel_masks(), mosaic(), and how CFA patterns are tiled and applied throughout training and inference.

docs.name: cfa-alignment-detection
docs.title: CFA Phase Shift Detection and Alignment
docs.description: How the system detects CFA phase offset relative to a canonical origin — find_pattern_shift(), detect_cfa_from_raw(), padding to canonical alignment. Used in both Python inference and the web preprocessor.

docs.name: unet-model-architecture
docs.title: U-Net Demosaicing Model Architecture
docs.description: The XTransUNet encoder-decoder: 4 levels with skip connections, residual CFA skip for exposure-agnostic output, CFA-agnostic 4-channel input (CFA value + 3 binary masks), configurable base_width.

docs.name: onnx-export
docs.title: ONNX Export Pipeline for Browser Inference
docs.description: How the PyTorch model is exported to ONNX format: fp16 conversion, metadata embedding, self-contained file, PSNR-based verification against the PyTorch original.

docs.name: dataset-build
docs.title: Training Dataset Build from RAW Files
docs.description: How RAW camera files become .npy training data: demosaic with DHT/AHD, black-level subtraction, normalization without clipping, 4x area-average downscale, metadata JSON sidecar.

docs.name: training-augmentations
docs.title: Training Data Augmentation Strategy
docs.description: CFA-aware augmentations during training: random crops aligned to CFA period, safe flips, additive Gaussian noise, white balance perturbation in log space, exposure shift toward clipping, OLPF blur simulation.

docs.name: torture-patterns
docs.title: Synthetic Torture Test Patterns
docs.description: Procedurally generated worst-case patterns (13 types) with 4x supersampling: diagonal stripes, Siemens star, Nyquist grid, chromatic edges, Julia fractals, Perlin noise. Purpose and mixing strategy during training.

docs.name: loss-functions
docs.title: Composite Demosaicing Loss Functions
docs.description: The DemosaicLoss system combining L1, MS-SSIM, Sobel gradient, chroma artifact, and color bias losses. Per-channel normalization for X-Trans green imbalance. Base vs finetune presets.

docs.name: training-loop
docs.title: Training Loop and Fine-tuning Modes
docs.description: The train.py training orchestration: AMP mixed precision, mode switching (train → finetune), torture pattern mixing, checkpoint management (best.pt, latest.pt), validation with PSNR tracking.

docs.name: raw-decoding-wasm
docs.title: RAW File Decoding via WASM
docs.description: The Rust WASM rawloader module for decoding RAF, CR2, ARW, NEF files in the browser. Metadata extraction (WB, black/white levels, XYZ matrix, crop boundaries, DR gain). Lazy initialization.

docs.name: cfa-preprocessing-web
docs.title: CFA Preprocessing in the Web Pipeline
docs.description: Preparing decoded CFA data for demosaicing: crop-to-visible, normalize to [0,1], white balance multiplication, mirror-pad to canonical CFA alignment, tile generation (288x288/48px overlap), channel mask building.

docs.name: highlight-reconstruction-opposed
docs.title: Opposed-Channel Highlight Inpainting
docs.description: First stage of highlight recovery: using unclipped color channels to estimate clipped ones in cube-root (perceptual) space. Fast, per-pixel operation applied before segmentation pass.

docs.name: highlight-reconstruction-segmentation
docs.title: Segmentation-Based Highlight Reconstruction
docs.description: Second-stage highlight recovery adapted from darktable: superpixel planes at 1/3 resolution, flood-fill segmentation of clipped regions, morphological closing, candidate selection, pseudo-chrominance transfer.

docs.name: demosaic-algorithm-dispatch
docs.title: Demosaic Algorithm Selection and Dispatch
docs.description: How the web app routes demosaicing: neural-net (tiled ONNX), or traditional algorithms via WebGPU compute (bilinear, DHT) or WASM worker pool (Markesteijn, AHD, PPG, MHC). Selection logic and fallback chain.

docs.name: worker-pool-parallelism
docs.title: WASM Worker Pool with Strip-Based Parallelism
docs.description: The DemosaicPool class: up to 8 workers via hardwareConcurrency, horizontal strip splitting with 3x CFA-period overlap, per-strip WASM invocation, non-overlapping region stitching. Bayer variant detection.

docs.name: webgpu-compute-demosaicing
docs.title: WebGPU Compute Shader Demosaicing
docs.description: GPU-accelerated bilinear (single-pass 5x5 window) and DHT (two-pass: directional green + homogeneity-weighted resolve) demosaicing via WebGPU compute shaders.

docs.name: tiled-inference-blending
docs.title: Tiled Neural Network Inference with Cosine Blending
docs.description: How large images are processed via ONNX Runtime: 288x288 tiles with 48px overlap, per-tile 4-channel input, cosine (raised-cosine) window blending to eliminate seams. WebGPU-first with WASM fallback.

docs.name: color-correction-pipeline
docs.title: Color Correction and Camera-to-sRGB Transform
docs.description: Building the 3x3 camera-to-sRGB matrix: invert xyzToCam, multiply by XYZ_TO_SRGB inverse, row-normalize for neutral white. Application to HWC pixel data. Fujifilm DR gain compensation.

docs.name: color-temperature-estimation
docs.title: Color Temperature and Tint Estimation from WB Coefficients
docs.description: McCamy's CCT approximation + Planckian locus distance for tint. Brute-force search for WB parameters matching target CCT/tint. Used to initialize grading sliders from camera metadata.

docs.name: webgpu-renderer
docs.title: WebGPU HdrRenderer for Real-Time Preview
docs.description: The HdrRenderer class: dual render pipelines (canvas display vs float-texture export), uniform buffer layout (304 bytes / 76 floats for OpenDRT params + preprocessing), histogram compute shaders, HDR histogram.

docs.name: opendrt-tone-mapping
docs.title: OpenDRT Tone Mapping and Color Grading
docs.description: The OpenDRT implementation: 47-parameter config, look presets (base/default/flat), tonescale derivation (precomputed shader constants), per-channel adjustments, brilliance. WGSL shader structure.

docs.name: hdr-display-export
docs.title: HDR Display Detection and Dual-Render Export
docs.description: HDR headroom probing, display capability detection, dual-render strategy (SDR Rec.709 + HDR Rec.2020), JPEG gain-map encoding, AVIF HLG output. Export format differences.

docs.name: opfs-pixel-storage
docs.title: OPFS Pixel Storage with Byte-Shuffle Compression
docs.description: Storing large HWC float32 buffers off-heap via Origin Private File System. Byte-shuffle preprocessing before gzip for 8-10x compression. Handoff cache to skip decompress on immediate reads. RAW and thumbnail storage.

docs.name: zustand-state-management
docs.title: Zustand Store and Per-File Grading State
docs.description: The useAppStore structure: file queue management, per-file processing status, per-file grading overrides (OpenDRT params, exposure, WB, sharpen), demosaic method selection, export settings.

docs.name: session-persistence
docs.title: IndexedDB Persistence and Session Restore
docs.description: Two IDB stores: 'files' (serialized results + grading) and 'settings' (global prefs). Debounced writes for slider changes. Session restore on init: IDB metadata + OPFS pixel validation. Orphan cleanup.

docs.name: gradio-inference-ui
docs.title: Gradio UI for Local Model Inference
docs.description: The ui.py Gradio web interface: RAF upload, model checkpoint selection with caching, tile overlap configuration, HDR AVIF output, confidence heatmap visualization, training history display.

docs.name: gpu-resident-nn-pipeline
docs.title: GPU-Resident Neural Network Pipeline
docs.description: The fully GPU-resident demosaicing path: tile-blend-gpu.ts (extract/accumulate/finalize/crop) and postprocess-gpu.ts (WB/HL/CC/DR on GPU). Zero CPU readback from tile extraction to final RGBA output.

docs.name: checkpoint-registry
docs.title: Checkpoint Registry and Multi-Model Management
docs.description: checkpoint_registry.py JSON registry, models.json manifest, browser-side ModelSize (S/M/L) switching, the full train→register→export→manifest→browser lifecycle.

docs.name: lensfun-integration
docs.title: LensFun Lens Profile Integration
docs.description: Client-side LensFun database matching: XML→JSON conversion, multi-strategy string matching (exact/substring/Jaccard), mount weighting, caching, integration with file processing and session restore.

docs.name: python-highlight-recovery
docs.title: Python Highlight Recovery (CFA and RGB Domains)
docs.description: Two-pass darktable-compatible highlight reconstruction in Python: inpaint-opposed + segmentation-based, in both CFA-domain (before demosaic) and RGB-domain (after demosaic+WB). Used by infer_hdr.py and ui.py.
